permitted_use: Other permitted uses, except as otherwise specified in this title

standards.SUBPART B: Minimum lot area of 750 sf per dwelling unit; unless 3 or more stories, then minimum lot area of 600 sf per dwelling unit; open space requirement of 40% of the lot area of an interior lot and 30% of a corner lot
standards.SUBPART D: Max height equal to the distance between the centerline of abutting street and face of the building abutting that street; above 60' in height an additional setback of l' is required from all yard lines for 2' of height above 60'.
